context.transcript:
Murat, thanks for meeting with me.
I was hoping to get your feedback on the new packaging for our tea biscuits.
Hi, Ayaka.
I really like the look of the new box, but I have one concern.
Will it keep the biscuits fresh longer?
Yes.
Our product testing team will send me their report soon.
We expect the new packaging will improve product shelf life by at least five days.
Great.
Hopefully you'll receive it before our meeting with investors next week.
They'll want to have that information before committing to continuing their support.
context.transcript_translation:
Murat，谢谢你和我见面。
我希望听听你对我们茶饼新包装的反馈。
嗨，Ayaka。
我真的很喜欢新盒子的外观，但有一个顾虑。
它能让饼干保持新鲜更长时间吗？
是的。
我们的产品测试团队很快会把报告发给我。
我们预计新的包装可以将产品的保质期提高至少五天。
太好了。
希望你能在下周和投资者开会前收到它。
他们想在承诺继续支持之前了解这些信息。
